has signed a merger agreement with an American smart lighting maker, Deako, aiming to lead the AI smart home, builder, and hotel markets, the company said on Thursday.
As consideration for the merger, SKYX will issue common stock equal to 18.46% of the company, totaling 25M shares subject to up to a 2-year lockup/leak-out agreement with a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan.
In addition, SKYX will pay Deako’s lender a payment of $4M by closing and issue a note of $8.5M, with $2.25M paid in Q-1 2027 and the remaining $6.25M in Q-4 2027.
Post merger, current SKYX’s shareholders will own 84.4% of the company, and Deako’s shareholders and lender collectively will own 15.6%.

title: SKYX signs merger agreement with Deako to combine plug-and-play smart home platforms
